attacker_pocs.why: A fixed-count grapheme-cluster repetition passes a lower bound one code unit before check_subject; the regional-indicator parity scan then reads before the subject allocation.

role_a_rationale: The interpreter now uses the validated subject boundary for grapheme-cluster backward scans, fixing the invalid-UTF read before the subject. The fixed-count repetition path contains an additional lower-bound arithmetic error that is reachable with a valid UTF-8 subject through pcre2_match().
